messages:
maya: quick async readout — SDK / quickstarts / samples
maya: shipped docs for the new JS client auth flow (tiny section + snippet). pushed a follow-up PR to reword the token rotation note.
maya: blocker: sampleapp Docker build flakes on GH actions (random OOM on macos runners)
sahil: thx — saw the doc PR, left a nit on the auth snippet (inline example uses const when we prefer let in that quickstart)
sahil: for Docker OOM — can you paste the failing step? sometimes node install + emcc in the build spikes mem
maya: failing step from GH logs: `RUN npm ci --legacy-peer-deps` then `yarn build:samples`
maya: stack excerpt: ```
ERROR: JavaScript heap out of memory
FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory
```
liam: fyi I hit that locally when packaging the typescript sample on M1, workaround was `NODE_OPTIONS=--max_old_space_size=4096 yarn build`
liam: we should add a note in CI to set NODE_OPTIONS for the sample build job, or split the build into smaller steps
ashley: +1 to splitting. for the quickstarts page, I can take the follow-up to add the NODE_OPTIONS hint and a link to the local workaround
maya: sweet, assign it if you have cycles. I'll open an issue for CI tweak and link to the PR that fails
sahil: quickcheck on SDK release: I bumped the Python SDK to 0.5.2 in the docs example — is that the right version for the hosted examples?
maya: yes 0.5.2 has the param rename we documented. we should also update the changelog snippet in the quickstart landing page
ashley: i'll update the quickstarts toc after the changelog is merged
liam: small code nudge: the sample snippet for streaming uses `for await (const chunk of client.stream(...))` — add an example of `onDelta` callback too, some users prefer the callback style
maya: noted. i'll add both variants in the sampleapp; want a short note on cost implications of streaming tokens?
ashley: yes, add a one-liner: "streaming may emit partial deltas — billing is token-based; test with short prompts to estimate cost"
devbot: deploy-bot: docs-site build succeeded for branch maya/docs-auth-2026 at 1755556120 :white_check_mark:
maya: awesome, thanks bot. next: today i'll triage the failing GH action, open the CI issue, and add a tiny docs blurb for NODE_OPTIONS. also will follow up on liam's streaming callback example.
sahil: i'll take the changelog update + confirm hosted examples match SDK pinned versions
ashley: i'll edit quickstarts TOC and add the one-liner about streaming costs.
liam: i'll split the sampleapp build into two jobs and test on an intel + M1 matrix later today
maya: if anyone wants the failing logs, i pasted the full gist here: https://gist.github.com/redwood/maya-sample-oom-175555
maya: cheers, ping me if you need review on the split-job PR or doc bits :)
ashley: thanks — <@maya> do you want me to block on the changelog PR before I update the TOC?
maya: no block, go ahead and add the TOC entry referencing the pending changelog PR (will update link once merged)
sahil: tiny docs nit I added in review: prefer `redwood.Client()` example to show explicit config object, not positional args
maya: good catch, converting the snippet now
liam: sounds good, i'll open the PR for the CI split and drop a note here when it lands
maya: last thing — can we add a one-line FAQ under quickstarts: "Why does my sample build OOM on GH actions?" with the NODE_OPTIONS hint and link to the issue
ashley: i'll draft that FAQ and ping for review
maya: end of readout. short and sweet today. :sparkles:
